test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which institution mainly provides financial assistance and support to microfinance institutions in India?

options.text: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)** primarily provides financial assistance and support to microfinance institutions in India.
 
• SIDBI was established in **1990** under an Act of the Indian Parliament to aid the growth and development of micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs).
 
• SIDBI offers **refinance facilities** to banks and financial institutions extending loans to the MSME sector, including microfinance institutions.
 
• It also provides **direct lending** to MSMEs and supports developmental initiatives aimed at strengthening the microfinance sector.
 
• SIDBI plays a crucial role in the implementation of various government schemes and programs to promote financial inclusion and entrepreneurship.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Microfinance Institutions (MFIs)** provide financial services to low-income individuals or those who do not have access to typical banking services.
 
• MFIs play a critical role in promoting financial inclusion by offering **microloans, savings, insurance, and other financial products** to the underserved population.
 
• The support from institutions like SIDBI helps MFIs in expanding their reach and enhancing their capability to serve the financially excluded segments of society.
 
• SIDBI also collaborates with various stakeholders, including the government, financial institutions, and international agencies, to create a conducive environment for the growth of microfinance in India.
 
• In addition to financial support, SIDBI also provides **capacity-building and technical assistance** to MFIs to improve their operational efficiency and sustainability.
